title: Shadow rotation advisor validated on synthetic fixtures (IMP-0019 shadow phase)
summary: Synthetic-fixture tests validated the shadow rotation advisor cost model, decision rules, explanation fields, privacy guarantees and shadow-mode invariants. Test modules: tests.test_rotation_advisor (9 tests on formulas, bootstrap fallback, semantic boundaries, decision edge, never-emitted compact/split_parallel, causality), tests.test_rotation_advisor_report (6 tests on deterministic aggregation, coverage counting, malformed-line handling, privacy assertions), tests.test_rotation_advisor_cli (1 test on CLI integration), tests.test_rotation_advisor_shadow (7 tests on shadow invariants, no worker file access, no dispatch changes, no engine imports). All 23 tests passed. Real-telemetry evaluation is pending the host command: `python -m agent_os.cli orchestrate rotation-advisor --out docs/orchestrator-os/self-audit/rotation-advisor-baseline.json`; results will be recorded separately once run.
